reviews.reason: 独立 Agent 评审完成；评分是基于本次证据的意见，不替代业务 QA 或人工评审。
reviews.summary: 针对“内部只读资料助手”，本评审按能力单元核对 AI 员工/工具注册、授权与权限集持久化、运行时组合与数据初始化、HTTP 路由与鉴权作用域四条链路。框架侧最实质的问题在 @nocobase/authorization：权限集标题解码对非 JSON 字符串无保护，坏数据会经 storedGrantProblems/AuthorizationProvider.start 中止整个应用启动（本 Run 已实际触发）。指引侧有两处误导：server-routes.md 的 use(path) 鉴权示例未说明参数化子路径漏配（应用据此实现后主管读取保密资料也得到 401，后改为逐路由鉴权），以及 AI 员工注册示例缺少 container.has 可选依赖守卫（repair-2 修复）。正面看，defineAIEmployee/defineTools + AIResourceRegistrar 是清晰可组合的扩展点，授权 Skill 也把 encodeAuthorizationTitle 契约写清楚了。B00 在第三轮验收通过；B01–B05 因测试环境未配置独立业务模型而 blocked，未据此推断问答能力。

modules.name: AI 员工、工具与 Skill 注册
modules.scope: 从 App 声明 AI 员工与只读工具，到由 AIResourceRegistrar 在 Provider.boot 注册进框架 AIManager 的完整链路，覆盖 @nocobase/ai-employee 声明 API、@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee 注册器与对应 Skill 指引。
modules.limitations: 未实际运行模型；员工回答质量与工具调用结果仅在 B01-B05 blocked 的基础上通过源码与日志间接判断。

requirementFit.reason: 声明式员工/工具与注册器覆盖了助手接入的核心需求，应用按指引即可落地。

usability.reason: 注册器生命周期清晰，但可选依赖守卫只在其他 Skill 出现，示例本身会误导。

requirements.responsibility: 库提供 encode/decode；指引规定 seed 使用 encodeAuthorizationTitle
requirements.recommendedUsage: seed 以 encodeAuthorizationTitle(标题) 写入 json 列
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 seed 初版写裸字符串触发崩溃，随后改为等价的 JSON.stringify；指引本身正确

requirements.need: 读取存量/手写权限集行时给出可定位错误，而不是让应用启动崩溃
requirements.responsibility: 框架的 decode/list/start 路径应容错或至少命名问题行
requirements.recommendedUsage: 对 json title 做校验并在错误中带上 permissionSet key
requirements.actualUsage: decodeAuthorizationTitle 对任意字符串先 JSON.parse，坏数据经 storedGrantProblems/start 传播，未捕获而中止启动

requirementFit.reason: 文档化的编码契约足以完成任务，但读取侧无容错，一行坏数据即可让应用不可用。

usability.reason: title 既接受字符串又强制 JSON 解析，语义不一致；启动错误不指出权限集。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引写得清楚，但运行期错误信息（Unexpected token）不足以让 agent 定位。

design.reason: 持久化契约集中在 core，但读写对称性缺失（encode 宽容、decode 严格无保护）。

reliability.reason: 启动关键路径上的未保护 JSON.parse 是可复现的可用性缺陷（本 Run 已实际触发）。

modules.name: HTTP 路由与认证中间件作用域
modules.scope: defineApiRoutes 的挂载、Hono 路由上的鉴权中间件作用域，以及 cookie 写请求的 CSRF 校验。
modules.limitations: 未在评审环境重跑 API；中间件作用域结论基于归档的修复前后 curl 证据。

requirements.need: defineApiRoutes 贡献被正确挂载到 /api 并由应用配置路由
requirements.responsibility: app-server 按 scope 挂载；工厂自建并返回 Hono
requirements.recommendedUsage: 不重复写 /api，路径相对挂载点
requirements.actualUsage: app/server/routes/documents.ts 用 defineApiRoutes 工厂返回 router，/api/documents 可访问

requirements.need: 每个路由自行鉴权，且中间件作用域显式覆盖所有子路径
requirements.responsibility: 路由 owner 用 auth.required() 保护每个 handler；指引给出正确作用域写法
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用定义时路径或独立子路由，避免无通配的 use(path) 漏配参数化路由
requirements.actualUsage: 初版 router.use('/documents', auth.required()) 未覆盖 /documents/:id，主管也收到 401；改为逐路由挂 authenticate 后正确

requirements.need: cookie 鉴权的写请求做 CSRF origin 校验
requirements.responsibility: 认证插件提供并执行 checkCookieWriteOrigin
requirements.recommendedUsage: 路由提供正确 origin，部署配置 trustedOrigins
requirements.actualUsage: 应用写路由在缺省 origin 下返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN，带正确 origin 后成功

requirementFit.reason: 挂载与逐路由鉴权最终满足资料 API 的访问控制需求。

usability.reason: 鉴权 API 简单，但作用域陷阱需要运行期发现。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引原则正确，缺少一个参数化路由的子路径示例。

design.reason: scope 挂载与工厂返回自有 router 的分层合理。

reliability.reason: CSRF 校验与逐路由鉴权有实现和运行证据，作用域问题已修复。

findings.title: 权限集标题解码对非 JSON 字符串无保护，可令应用启动崩溃
findings.detail: decodeAuthorizationTitle 对任何字符串先执行 JSON.parse；permissionSetFromRow 直接调用它，AuthorizationProvider.start 又通过 storedGrantProblems 无条件遍历，开发期 reportStoredGrants 抛错。裸标题（例如历史数据、手工 SQL 或未按文档写入的行）会以 SyntaxError 中止整个启动。
findings.impact: 一行不符合文档编码契约的 title 就能让应用完全无法启动，且错误只报告 JSON 解析失败，不指出是哪条权限集。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 decodeAuthorizationTitle/permissionSetFromRow 捕获解析错误并抛出带 permissionSet key 与 title 的诊断；或在 list() 中校验并降级为纯字符串，把扫描结果作为可读错误而非未捕获异常。

findings.title: server-routes 指引的 use(path) 鉴权示例会漏掉参数化子路径
findings.detail: 指引在“An authenticated endpoint”给出 router.use('/orders', auth.required())，并把该资源视为受保护；但同一 router 上的 /documents/:id 未被这条 use 覆盖。应用照此编写后，主管请求保密资料也得到 401，只有把 authenticate 挂到每个路由才修复。
findings.impact: 读者按示例为资源加鉴权时，参数化或兄弟路径可能静默无认证；本例因业务层还有一次校验而表现为功能失败，若 handler 直接信任 context auth 则可能是安全缺口。
findings.suggestedChange: 在示例中补充参数化/多路径的写法（逐路由挂中间件或把子路由挂在自有前缀下），并明确 use('/x') 的作用域不自动覆盖需要单独声明的路径；给出一个反例说明如何自测匿名与该资源所有路径。
findings.claimed: router.use('/orders', auth.required()) 被视为保护该资源的鉴权写法，资源下的其余路径随之受保护。
findings.observed: 同一 router 的 /documents/:id 未被该 use 覆盖，主管请求得到 401；改为每个路由挂 authenticate 后 403/200 才正确。

findings.title: AI 员工注册指引的 boot 示例缺少可选依赖守卫
findings.detail: server-runs.md 的 Register App resources 示例直接 container.resolve(aiManagerToken)。当宿主组合未注册 AI 员工插件时该 token 未绑定，boot 抛错使应用无法启动；repair-2 才加入 container.has(aiManagerToken) 守卫，而调度器与工作流 Skill 已示范了该守卫。
findings.impact: 在测试/裁剪运行时组合 Provider 时产生一次额外的崩溃—修复轮，增加启动失败风险。
findings.suggestedChange: 在示例中加入 if (!this.app.container.has(aiManagerToken)) return; 并说明哪些集成属于可选依赖。
findings.claimed: 示例的 boot() 直接 resolve(aiManagerToken) 并注册，适用于任何组合。
findings.observed: 插件未安装时 token 未绑定，boot 抛错；应用需额外加 container.has 守卫才能在该组合下启动。

findings.title: AI 员工/工具声明与注册器提供了清晰、可组合的扩展点
findings.detail: defineAIEmployee/defineTools 保持声明式身份函数，AIResourceRegistrar 作为公开抽象类把 tools→skills→employees 的注册顺序封装起来，App 通过覆盖 registerTools/registerAIEmployees 即可接入，且注册被限定在显式 boot 生命周期。
findings.impact: 降低了助手接入的实现与升级成本，应用可复用同一注册器而不接触内部 manager。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该分层；可在 registrar 文档中补充一个参数化工具权限的示例。

findings.title: 授权 Skill 明确规定了 title 编码与持久化行形状
findings.detail: code-and-seeds.md 给出 encodeAuthorizationTitle 的导入与用法、authorizationPermissionSets/Assignments 的列形状与幂等要求，本应用据此（等价地）写出可启动的 seed。
findings.impact: 把易错的 JSON 编码契约前置到指引，避免了按直觉写裸字符串。
findings.suggestedChange: 可在同一文档补一句读取侧对历史坏数据的处理建议，形成读写闭环。

findings.title: 资料账号 seed 初版用裸字符串写 title 导致启动崩溃
findings.detail: 应用首次写入 accounts seed 时把 authorizationPermissionSets.title 设为 'Supervisor'/'Colleague'，与文档编码契约不符，触发权限集解码崩溃；读到 code-and-seeds.md 后改为 JSON.stringify（等价于 encodeAuthorizationTitle）。
findings.impact: 一次可避免的启动崩溃与修复轮，说明指引读取晚于 seed 编写。
findings.suggestedChange: 应用在写持久化 json 列前先检索对应 Skill 的编码契约；seed 增加对 title 解码的自检。

An importable subpath is not a runtime contribution. `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/server` exports tokens and the registrar base class; importing it never registers anything. Registration happens in the App's own Provider, once, in `boot()`.

Import a token from the package that created it. `createServiceToken` is keyed by object identity, so a second `createServiceToken('ai-manager')` is a different key that resolves nothing.

## Prerequisites

1. `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee` is registered in `server/plugins.ts` and `client/plugins.ts`. Those two files are the registration; `package.json#nocobase` carries template metadata and no plugin list, so do not look for one there or add one.
2. `config.yml` declares at least one usable `ai.llmServices` entry. Nothing works without it, its models must be real, and where its key lives is the user's choice among three places — see [capabilities.md § LLM services](references/capabilities.md#llm-services-configyml) and [§ Where the key lives](references/capabilities.md#where-the-key-lives).
3. Frontend work needs `client/extensions/nocobase-ai/index.ts` to exist. If it does not, install the Registry item first — see [chat-surfaces.md § Install the extension](references/chat-surfaces.md#install-the-extension).
4. Chat attachments need a storage disk decided deliberately — see [capabilities.md § Attachment storage](references/capabilities.md#attachment-storage-configyml).
5. Business data the assistant should read is already authorized, and its authorization resource id is two-part — `<connection>.<collection>`. The built-in data tools skip a bare `orders`, and what they skip disappears in silence: discovery returns no data sources at all, not one missing table, so the symptom points at the database configuration rather than the grant. Authorization itself belongs to the `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill; what this plugin requires of it is in [capabilities.md § What the data tools can see](references/capabilities.md#what-the-data-tools-can-see).
6. The AI employee page reports results through `useToaster()` from `@nocobase/app-client`, so the App needs the `@nocobase/app-client` that exports it and registers a toaster service, as the templates do: `client/lib/toaster.ts` from the template, and `this.app.container.instance(toasterToken, createToaster())` in the `register()` of `client/service-provider.ts`, with the `Toaster` component mounted in `client/react-providers.ts`. Without the registration nothing throws, but its toasts are only logged to the browser console. Update `@nocobase/app-client` together with this plugin; the `nocobase-app-upgrade` Skill's `references/edge-cases.md` ("Notifications and the application toaster") has the full steps.

## Known gaps in this version

One thing does not yet work the way it should. It is an open defect rather than intended behaviour, and a fix is planned; it cannot be fixed from the App in the meantime, so work around it until the release that closes it. If you are reading this from a newer version of the plugin, check whether it still applies before designing around it.

- **`.env` works only under `pnpm dev`.** `${NAME}` in `ai.llmServices` and `ai.mcpServers` expands from `process.env`. `pnpm dev` passes a merged environment to the server process, so it works; `pnpm start` loads the built server in-process and the application's `.env` is not merged into `process.env`, so the placeholder becomes an empty string and the provider reports an authentication failure. Until that is fixed, `.env` is the last of the three places a key can live, and a deployment sets a real environment variable or writes the value into its own `config.yml`.

## Every route owns its own security

**Mounting under `/api` does not authenticate anything.** `/api` is a location. A route with no `auth.required()` is public regardless of where it mounts.

Never depend on middleware installed by another route, or on the order contributions happen to be registered in. Contribution order changes when a plugin is added, and a route protected only by someone else's middleware silently becomes public.

`auth.required()` rejects anonymous requests with `401`. `auth.optional()` attaches the session when present without rejecting.

Use `--restore-save auto` by default so a failed restore does not overwrite the previous known-good state. agent-browser --session b open https://app.example.com
agent-browser --session a fill @e1 "alice@test.com"
agent-browser --session b fill @e1 "bob@test.com"
```

`AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=myapp` sets the default session for the current shell.

agent-browser network har start                                    # record all traffic
# ... perform actions ...
agent-browser network har stop /tmp/trace.har

agent-browser doctor --offline --quick   # fast, local-only
